name: メディアンフィルタリング検出
description: 検出します traces of median filtering applied to suppress JPEG アーティファクト and hide 改ざん evidence.
algorithm: Median Filtered Image Forensics via First-Digit Analysis
mechanism: 分析します pixel value 分布s を検出するために the smoothing アーティファクト characteristic of median filtering. Median filtering removes high-frequency noise but leaves detectable traces in the ヒストグラム and pixel co-occurrence matrices.
parameters: Window sizes: 3×3, 5×5, 7×7; Feature: ヒストグラム bin 分析, pixel auto相関, streak 分析
source: Kirchner, M. & Fridrich, J. (2010) — On Detection of Median Filtering in Digital Images, SPIE Electronic Imaging
useCase: Detecting anti-フォレンジック median filtering used to conceal 画像操作 or AI generation traces

references.title: Kirchner, M. & Fridrich, J. (2010) — On Detection of Median Filtering in Digital Images, SPIE Electronic Imaging

strengths:
• Robust 検出 of median filtering traces
• Works にわたる different window sizes
• Effective anti-フォレンジック countermeasure
• Low 誤検出 rate
limitations:
• Cannot detect very light filtering
• May confuse with other smoothing filters
• Requires sufficient image 解像度
• Performance degrades with heavy JPEG圧縮
